title: Professor
description: A reusable SVG character that writes and presents step-by-step fraction solutions.
paragraphs: The Professor combines a reusable SVG character and presentation rig with a two-link drawing arm. The character walks into writing range, lifts the chalk between strokes, and turns toward the viewer to explain each transformation.

An independent exact-rational mathematics engine generates and verifies fraction problems and solution steps. A separate layout engine positions stacked fractions and aligned equals signs before converting them into timed handwriting strokes.

The compact homepage demonstration runs silently and loops automatically. The full writing application includes problem selection, speech, step-by-step playback, timeline seeking, and body-rig controls. Both use the same engines, with a static completed scene for reduced-motion visitors in compact mode.
